title: Advanced Professional Certificate in Strategic Management and Business Analysis
description: Discover how to make a strategy acceptable for all stakeholders and understand the challenges facing strategy implementation, different organizational structures, and control.
longDescription: This course offers a comprehensive understanding of strategy formulation, implementation, and evaluation and the essential role of business analysis in achieving success. You'll learn about the Strategy-Formulation Analytical Framework and explore the dynamics of Culture Aspects of Strategy Choice and the Politics of Strategy Choice. Discover how to make a strategy acceptable for all stakeholders and understand the challenges facing strategy implementation, different organizational structures, and control. Learn about the role of a strategic centre firm and explore various business analysis techniques, including useful financial ratios and modern tools. Through engaging content, you'll apply your knowledge and hone your business analysis skills. Whether you are an experienced executive or an aspiring entrepreneur, this course will equip you with the knowledge and tools you need to succeed in today's competitive business world.
courseDetails: Understand the nature of strategy implementation. Elaborate on the challenges facing strategy implementation. Explain different organisational structures and control. Illustrate the relationship between the strategy and structure of an organisation. Understand how role of a strategic centre firm. Understand the nature of business analysis and its role. Explain the business analysis process and business analytics. Describe different business analysis techniques. Explore different useful financial ratios applicable to business analysis. Understand different modern, useful tools of business analysis. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Understanding the Strategy Formulation: Concepts in Implementing Strategies: Concepts in Strategy Evaluation: Understanding Business Analysis: Business Analysis Case Studies:
